approval.statement: Approves all statements and schedules included in this Statement of Financial Information.

definitions.remuneration: Includes any form of salary, wage, gratuities and taxable benefits, including applicable vehicle allowances paid to the employee.
definitions.expenses: Includes travel expenses, memberships, tuition, relocation, vehicle reimbursements, and registration fees paid directly to an employee or to a third party on behalf of an employee.
definitions.financialStatementRelation: Schedule is based on actual payments made during the year; financial statements are prepared on an accrual basis.
definitions.sourceNamedSubtotalLabel: Subtotal - employees with remuneration and expenses exceeding $75,000
definitions.thresholdMeaning: Retain every printed named row, including individual remuneration below$75,000. Do not silently convert this combined source label into a salary-only selection rule.
